meanings.usage: 指自然流动的水道，如 the Thames, the Yangtze River
指河流的岸边，也指银行金融机构
描述温度适中，不冷不热
指中午12点到傍晚之间的时间
child的复数形式，指年龄较小的人
指有规则的活动或体育运动
描述事情发生得很快且出乎意料
用脚踢球或其他物体的动作
形容正在经过某地的事物
指用力碰撞或击中某人或某物
表示非常接近但未完全达到
指突然明白或发现某事

examples.en: The Wayle is a small river that cuts across the park.
examples.zh: 韦尔河是一条穿过我家附近公园的小河。

examples.en: I went and sat on the river bank as usual.
examples.zh: 我像往常一样去河边坐着。

examples.en: Some people on the bank called out to the man in the boat.
examples.zh: 岸上的一些人向船里的男人大声喊叫。

examples.en: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.
examples.zh: 球重重地击中了他，他差点掉进水里。

examples.en: It went towards a passing boat.
examples.zh: 它朝一条经过的船飞去。

examples.en: He threw the ball back to the bank.
Some children were playing games on the bank.
examples.zh: 一些孩子在岸上玩游戏。

examples.en: I like sitting by the Wayle on fine afternoons.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在晴朗的下午坐在韦尔河边。

grammar.title: 一般过去时 (Simple Past Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的动作或存在的状态 描述过去某一具体时间发生的动作或事件

examples.zh: 上个星期天天气很暖和。

examples.en: The ball struck him so hard.
He laughed when he realized what had happened.
examples.zh: 当他意识到发生了什么时，他笑了。

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing + 其他
grammar.definition: 表示过去某一时刻或时间段正在进行的动作 描述过去正在进行的动作，常与 when, while 等连用

examples.en: Some children were playing games on the bank.
examples.zh: 一些孩子在岸上玩游戏。

examples.en: Some people were rowing on the river.

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词 + 其他
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作 描述在过去的过去已经发生的事情

examples.en: They had all run away before I could react.
examples.zh: 在我反应过来之前他们都已经跑走了。
他意识到发生了什么（指在那个时刻之前就已经发生了）。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be动词(过去式) + 形容词 + 时间点

original.zh: 上个星期天天气很暖和。

original.en: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.
original.zh: 球重重地击中了他，他差点掉进水里。

imitations.en: She spoke so fast that nobody could understand her.
imitations.zh: 她说得太快了，没人能听懂。

imitations.en: The box was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + 动词(过去式) + when + 句子

original.en: He laughed when he realized what had happened.
original.zh: 当他意识到发生了什么时，他笑了。

imitations.en: She cried when she heard the news.
imitations.zh: 当她听到这个消息时，她哭了。

imitations.en: The teacher smiled when he saw the students.
imitations.zh: 当老师看到学生们时，他笑了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + 动词(过去式) + ...to + 地点/人

original.en: He called out to the children and threw the ball back to the bank.
original.zh: 他向孩子们喊叫，并把球扔回岸上。

lines.en: The Wayle is a small river that cuts across the park near my home.
lines.zh: 威尔河是横穿过我家附近公园的一条小河。

lines.en: I like sitting by the Wayle on fine afternoons.
lines.zh: 我喜欢在天气晴朗的下午到河边坐坐。

lines.en: It was warm last Sunday, so I went and sat on the river bank as usual.
lines.zh: 上星期日天气很暖和。于是我和往常一样，又去河边坐着。

lines.en: Some children were playing games on the bank and there were some people rowing on the river.
lines.zh: 河岸上有些孩子正在玩耍，河面上有些人正在划船。

lines.en: Suddenly, one of the children kicked a ball very hard and it went towards a passing boat.
lines.zh: 突然，一个孩子狠狠地踢了一脚球，球便向着一只划过来的小船飞去。

lines.en: Some people on the bank called out to the man in the boat, but he did not hear them.
lines.zh: 岸上的一些人对着小船上的人高喊，但他没有听见。

lines.en: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.
lines.zh: 球重重地打在他身上，使他差点儿落入水中。

lines.en: I turned to look at the children, but there weren't any in sight: they had all run away!
lines.zh: 我转过头去看那些孩子，但一个也不见，全都跑了！

lines.en: The man laughed when he realized what had happened.
lines.zh: 当那个人明白了发生的事情时，笑了起来。

lines.en: He called out to the children and threw the ball back to the bank.
lines.zh: 他大声叫着那些孩子，把球扔回到岸上。

questions.q: What happened to the man in the boat?
questions.zh: 船上的那个人发生了什么事？
questions.a: A child kicked a ball very hard; it went towards a passing boat and struck the man so hard that he nearly fell into the water.
questions.aZh: 一个孩子狠狠踢了一脚球，球飞向一只划过来的小船，重重地打在那人身上，他差点儿落入水中。
questions.hint: 见第 5、7 句：it went towards a passing boat 与 The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water。

questions.q: How is the Wayle described in the opening sentence, and where does the writer like to sit?
questions.zh: 开头怎样描写威尔河？作者喜欢坐在哪里？
questions.a: It is a small river that cuts across the park near his home, and he likes sitting by the Wayle on fine afternoons.
questions.aZh: 威尔河是横穿他家附近公园的一条小河；他喜欢在天气晴朗的下午坐在河边。

questions.q: What did the people on the bank do when the ball went towards the boat?
questions.zh: 球飞向小船时，岸上的人做了什么？
questions.a: Some people on the bank called out to the man in the boat, but he did not hear them.
questions.aZh: 岸上的一些人对着船上的人高声喊叫，但他没有听见。

questions.q: Why couldn't the writer see any children when he turned to look at them?
questions.zh: 作者转过头去看孩子们时，为什么一个也看不见？
questions.a: Because they had all run away — there weren't any in sight.
questions.aZh: 因为他们全都跑掉了，视野里一个孩子也没有。
questions.hint: 见第 8 句：there weren't any in sight。

questions.q: Why did the man laugh and throw the ball back, and what is funny about the title Football or polo?
questions.zh: 船上的人为什么笑了并把球扔回岸上？标题妙在哪里？
questions.a: He realised it was only an accident, not an attack, so he laughed and threw the ball back to the bank. The joke is that a football knocked among boats on a river nearly becomes water polo.
questions.aZh: 他明白这不过是孩子们的意外而非恶意，于是笑着把球扔回岸上。妙处在于足球被打到河上的小船之间，几乎成了“水球”。
questions.hint: 结合末两句 realized what had happened、threw the ball back to the bank。

translation:
威尔河是横穿过我家附近公园的一条小河。
我喜欢在天气晴朗的下午到河边坐坐。
上星期日天气很暖和。
于是我和往常一样，又去河边坐着。
河岸上有些孩子正在玩耍，河面上有些人正在划船。
突然，一个孩子狠狠地踢了一脚球，球便向着一只划过来的小船飞去。
岸上的一些人对着小船上的人高喊，但他没有听见。
球重重地打在他身上，使他差点儿落入水中。
我转过头去看那些孩子，但一个也不见，全都跑了！
当那个人明白了发生的事情时，笑了起来。
他大声叫着那些孩子，把球扔回到岸上。
title: Football or polo?
subtitle: 足球还是水球？

lead.question: 河边的一场球赛，为什么让船上的人差点落水？
lead.warmup: 晴朗的下午，作者照例坐在威尔河畔：岸上孩子嬉戏，河面有人划船，一切安静平常。可一脚狠踢改变了画面——球直奔小船而去，岸上人高声喊叫，船上人却没听见，被球击中后险些落水。等他弄清原委，反倒笑着把球扔回岸上。读完后想一想：标题为什么叫 Football or polo？
goals: 掌握 cut across、row、kick、call out、in sight 等核心词语
理解 so...that 结果状语从句与 passing 作定语
辨析 some/any 以及 a、the 与零冠词的使用场合
能用本课句式复述这起河边意外
lead.summary: 课文以第一人称讲述河边小插曲：作者常坐在横穿公园的威尔河畔；某个暖和的星期天，孩子踢出的球飞向小船，击中了没听见呼喊的船中人，他险些落水。回头看时孩子们早已跑光，弄清原委后他笑着把球扔回岸上。全文用一般过去时叙事，穿插过去进行时，so...that 与 in sight 是理解关键。
lead.tips: 河流名 the Wayle 必须带 the；on fine afternoons 有修饰语用 on、复数表经常性；否定句中 some 要改成 any，in sight 中间不加冠词。

exercises.q: 填空：The Wayle is a small river ____ cuts ____ the park near my home.
exercises.note: that 作主语；cut across 横穿。

exercises.q: 填入冠词：____ Wayle is ____ small river.
填空：I like sitting ____ the Wayle ____ fine afternoons. It was warm last Sunday, so I sat on the river bank ____ ____.
exercises.note: by 在…旁；有修饰语用 on。

exercises.q: 改为否定句：There were some people rowing on the river.
exercises.a: There weren't any people rowing on the river.
exercises.note: 否定句中 some 改 any。

exercises.q: 填空：Some people on the bank ____ ____ to the man in the boat.（朝…高喊）
exercises.note: call out to sb. 朝某人喊。

exercises.q: 汉译英：突然一个孩子狠狠踢了一脚球，球打在船上的人身上，他差点儿落水。
exercises.a: Suddenly, one of the children kicked a ball very hard and it struck the man in the boat so hard that he nearly fell into the water.

exercises.q: 汉译英：我转过头去看那些孩子，但一个也不见——全都跑了！
exercises.a: I turned to look at the children, but there weren't any in sight: they had all run away!

quiz.q: 课文中“威尔河横穿过公园”，“横穿”用哪个短语？
options: cut across
cut down
cut off
cut into
quiz.note: cut down 砍倒，cut off 切断。

quiz.q: “我喜欢在天气晴朗的下午坐在河边”，哪句正确？
options: I like sitting by the Wayle in fine afternoons.
I like sitting by the Wayle on fine afternoons.
I like sitting by the Wayle at fine afternoons.
I like sit by the Wayle on fine afternoon.
quiz.note: 有修饰语用 on，复数表经常。

quiz.q: 河流名 the Wayle 为什么用定冠词 the？
options: 河流等专有名词前通常加 the
因为 Wayle 以元音字母开头
因为它是复数名词
因为上文从未提过
quiz.note: 江河、海洋、山脉前加 the。

quiz.q: called out to the man in the boat 中 called out to 是什么意思？
options: make a phone call to
call off
shout loudly to
pay a visit to
quiz.note: call out 比 call 语气更重。

quiz.q: “我转过头去看孩子们，但一个也看不见”，课文原句是？
options: There weren't any children in the sight.
There weren't some children in sight.
There weren't any in the sight.
There weren't any in sight.
quiz.note: in sight 固定搭配不加 the。

quiz.q: “球打得如此之重，他差点掉进水里”，哪句正确？
options: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.
The ball struck him so hardly that he nearly fell into the water.
The ball struck him such hard that he nearly fell into the water.
The ball struck him very hard that he nearly fell into the water.
